items.title: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope: Falcon Heavy Passes Max Q
items.content_text: The SpaceX Falcon Heavy carrying NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope passed Max Q, the point of maximum aerodynamic pressure during ascent. Max Q occurs when the combination of the rocket’s speed and surrounding air pressure places the greatest mechanical stress on the rocket.

items.title: NASA Roman Space Telescope: Second Stage LOX Loading at 7:07 a.m. EDT
items.content_text: SpaceX confirms that liquid oxygen, or LOX, loading is now underway for Falcon Heavy’s second stage. All the major propulsion elements of the rocket carrying NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope spacecraft are now in propellant-loading operations at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
